Klasse PasswordUtil

java.lang.Object
de.hitec.nhplus.utils.PasswordUtil
public final class PasswordUtil extends Object
Stateless utility for password security.

Bundles everything the login system needs to handle passwords safely: generating a random salt, hashing a password with SHA-256 over that salt, verifying a candidate password against a stored hash, generating a secure one-time password and validating a password against the policy. Clear-text passwords are never stored — only salt and hash.

Single responsibility: password cryptography and policy only. The class is final and has a private constructor, so it cannot be instantiated or extended; all methods are static.

  • Methodendetails

    • generateSalt

      public static String generateSalt()
      Generates a new random 16-byte salt, encoded as a lower-case hex string.
      Gibt zurück:
      the freshly generated salt

    • hash

      public static String hash(String password, String salt)
      Hashes a password with SHA-256 over the given salt.
      Parameter:
      password - the clear-text password to hash
      salt - the salt to mix in (see generateSalt())
      Gibt zurück:
      the resulting hash as a lower-case hex string
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the SHA-256 algorithm is not available in the JVM

    • verify

      public static boolean verify(String password, String salt, String expectedHash)
      Verifies a candidate password against a stored hash by re-hashing it with the stored salt and comparing the results.
      Parameter:
      password - the clear-text password to check
      salt - the salt that was used for the stored hash
      expectedHash - the stored hash to compare against
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the password matches, false otherwise

    • generateSecurePassword

      public static String generateSecurePassword()
      Generates a random 8-character one-time password.

      Drawn from a character set that mixes upper-case letters, lower-case letters, digits and special characters while leaving out easily confused characters (such as I, l, O, 0, 1). The result always satisfies isValidPassword(String).

      Gibt zurück:
      a newly generated secure password

    • isValidPassword

      public static boolean isValidPassword(String password)
      Checks whether a password fulfils the password policy: at least 8 characters and containing at least one upper-case letter, one lower-case letter and one special character.
      Parameter:
      password - the password to validate (may be null)
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the password meets all requirements, false otherwise
